spec.name: Cyberpunk 2077: Weapon & Gear Loadout
spec.genInstructions: Build an equipment loadout panel with weapon slots (primary, secondary, melee), armor/clothing slots, an item rarity/stat display, and buy/sell actions for gear management.
spec.role: Handles the player's equipped weapons and armor, driving the Armor rating on the Vitals HUD and moving currency through the Eddies bar on transactions.

targets.name: Cyberpunk 2077: Character Vitals HUD
targets.description: When the user equips/unequips clothing or armor, emit the summed armor rating so the Vitals HUD updates its Armor bar value and numeric readout.

targets.name: Cyberpunk 2077: Eddies & Street Cred Bar
targets.description: When the user buys or sells an item, emit the signed eddies amount (negative on purchase, positive on sale) so the Eddies bar debits or credits the balance and plays the count animation.

style:
- Outermost container background: bg-zinc-950 with a subtle radial glow — apply bg-[radial-gradient(ellipse_at_top,#1a0b2e_0%,#0a0a0f_60%)] over bg-zinc-950
- Card/panel surface: bg-[#0d0d14]/95 with bg-[linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(21,15,40,0.9)_0%,rgba(10,10,20,0.95)_100%)], backdrop-blur-sm
- Inset/recessed surface: bg-black/60 with an inner darkening — use bg-[#07070c] and shadow-[inset_0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.8)]
- Track/bar-groove surface (for meter backgrounds): bg-cyan-950/40

- Panel border: border border-cyan-400/30 (NEVER white borders anywhere)
- Panel radius: rounded-lg
- Input/inset border: border border-cyan-500/20, rounded-md
- Button border: border border-yellow-300/40, rounded-md
- Chip/tag border: border border-fuchsia-500/40, rounded-sm
- Accent divider / glitch-frame edge: border-l-2 border-yellow-300/70 for active/highlighted edges; use ring-1 ring-cyan-400/20 for soft framing

- Primary text: text-cyan-50
- Secondary text: text-cyan-300/80
- Muted/disabled text: text-slate-500
- Primary accent fill (CTA / active): bg-yellow-300 text-black
- Secondary accent fill: bg-cyan-500/20 text-cyan-200
- Accent text: text-cyan-300; accent border color: border-cyan-400
- Magenta accent (reputation/street-cred/quest): text-fuchsia-400, bg-fuchsia-500/15
- Semantic success (health/positive): text-lime-400, bg-lime-500/20, fill bg-lime-400
- Semantic warning (stamina/armor/caution): text-amber-400, bg-amber-500/20, fill bg-amber-400
- Semantic danger (low health/damage/sell): text-red-500, bg-red-500/20, fill bg-red-500
- RAM / intelligence meter fill: bg-cyan-400; Armor fill: bg-slate-300 → prefer bg-sky-400; Health fill: bg-red-500; Stamina fill: bg-lime-400; Eddies/currency: text-yellow-300
- Rarity tier colors: common text-slate-300, uncommon text-lime-400, rare text-sky-400, epic text-fuchsia-400, legendary text-yellow-300

- Heading font: font-mono font-bold tracking-widest uppercase text-cyan-50, text-lg leading-tight
- Sub-heading/section label: font-mono font-semibold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-cyan-300/80, text-xs leading-tight
- Body text: font-sans font-normal tracking-normal text-cyan-100/90, text-sm leading-snug
- Label text: font-mono font-medium tracking-wider uppercase text-slate-400, text-[10px] leading-none
- Caption text: font-mono font-normal tracking-wide text-slate-500, text-[10px] leading-tight
- DISPLAY text (large readouts, numerals, bar values, eddies counter): font-mono font-black tracking-tight text-yellow-300, with text-shadow via drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(253,224,71,0.6)] (no font-size)
- DISPLAY text on buttons/pads: font-mono font-bold tracking-[0.15em] uppercase text-black (on yellow fills) or text-cyan-100 (on dark fills) (no font-size)

- Inter-component gap: gap-3
- Card padding: p-3
- Compact item / row padding: p-2
- Chip padding: px-2 py-1
- Tight inline gap: gap-2

- Header/title bar FIXED HEIGHT: h-9; appearance: px-3, border-b border-cyan-400/30, bg-[linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(6,182,212,0.15)_0%,rgba(217,70,239,0.08)_100%)]; title type: font-mono font-bold tracking-[0.25em] uppercase text-cyan-100 with drop-shadow-[0_0_6px_rgba(34,211,238,0.5)]
- Footer/status strip FIXED HEIGHT: h-7; appearance: px-3, border-t border-cyan-500/20, bg-black/50; type: font-mono tracking-wider uppercase text-[10px] text-cyan-400/70

- Elevation floating panels: shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(34,211,238,0.15),0_0_40px_rgba(217,70,239,0.08)]
- Elevation active/selected element: shadow-[0_0_16px_rgba(253,224,71,0.4)]
- Flat/inset surfaces: shadow-none (rely on inset shadow token above)
- Glow accent for markers/status icons: drop-shadow-[0_0_6px_currentColor]

- Base transition: transition-all duration-200 ease-out
- Bar/meter value animation: transition-[width] duration-500 ease-[cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1)]
- Button hover: hover:bg-yellow-200 hover:shadow-[0_0_18px_rgba(253,224,71,0.6)] hover:-translate-y-px active:translate-y-0 active:brightness-90
- Secondary/ghost button hover: hover:bg-cyan-500/30 hover:border-cyan-400/60 hover:text-cyan-100
- Row hover: hover:bg-cyan-500/10 hover:border-l-2 hover:border-cyan-400
- Interactive chip hover: hover:bg-fuchsia-500/25 hover:border-fuchsia-400 hover:text-fuchsia-200 hover:shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(217,70,239,0.4)]
- Marker/quest hover: hover:scale-110 hover:drop-shadow-[0_0_10px_rgba(253,224,71,0.7)]
- Glitch/flash feedback (on stat change, tracked-quest, transaction): apply animate-pulse on the changed value plus a momentary ring-2 ring-fuchsia-400/60
- Locked/disabled state: opacity-40 grayscale, no hover response
- Danger/sell action hover: hover:bg-red-500/30 hover:border-red-400 hover:text-red-300; Success/buy action hover: hover:bg-lime-500/30 hover:border-lime-400 hover:text-lime-300

library.description: Horizontal depletable bar showing value out of max (value in the same unit as max, clamped to 0..max); optional discrete segment count renders it as blocks (e.g. RAM); optional numeric overlay of current/max.
Framed animated character portrait surface rendering a supplied image with an optional glitch/scanline animation intensity (0-1).
Strip of active status-effect indicators; each effect may show remaining duration as a normalized 0-1 fraction, and effects can be hovered/selected by id.

props.effects: { id: string; label: string; iconUrl?: string; remaining?: number; tone?: 'buff' | 'debuff' | 'neutral' }[]

library.description: Single numeric or short-text readout; when a number is supplied and animate is set, it counts (tweens) from the previous value to the new one. Unit/meaning is defined by the component supplying the value.
Momentary push button that fires once per press; face content (label/glyph) is supplied as children.
Latching two-state button; pressing flips the boolean state and emits the new state. Face content is supplied as children.

Scrollable list of multi-field option rows (label plus optional sublabel, detail, meta, locked flag and nested child rows); one row is selected by id, rows can be expanded by id, and activation (open/apply) is a separate event.

props.options: { id: string; label: string; sublabel?: string; detail?: string; meta?: string | number; locked?: boolean; tone?: 'neutral' | 'accent' | 'danger'; children?: { id: string; label: string; detail?: string; done?: boolean }[] }[]

library.description: Single-row segmented selector of mutually exclusive named categories; emits the chosen option id.

props.options: { id: string; label: string; count?: number }[]

library.description: A single equip/install slot that either shows its held item (name, rarity tier, icon) or an empty state; can be locked and can be selected, emitting its slot id.

props.item?: { id: string; name: string; rarity?: 'common' | 'uncommon' | 'rare' | 'epic' | 'legendary'; iconUrl?: string }

library.description: Read-only key/value stat listing for a selected item, implant or reward set; each entry may carry a signed delta relative to the current state.

props.entries: { label: string; value: string | number; delta?: number; tone?: 'neutral' | 'positive' | 'negative' }[]

library.description: Anatomical figure surface that positions child slot elements at named body regions in the diagram's own coordinates.

props.regions: { id: string; label: string; x: number; y: number }[]

library.description: Full-body character render showing the currently equipped gear set; items are supplied as an ordered layer list.

props.layers?: { id: string; iconUrl?: string; slot: string }[]

library.description: Pan/zoomable dark map surface; content is drawn in normalized 0-1 map coordinates and the view is described by zoom factor and center point, emitting changes on user pan/zoom.

props.onViewChange: (view: { zoom: number; center: { x: number; y: number } }) => void

library.description: Point marker placed at normalized 0-1 map coordinates, with a kind (quest, poi, player, waypoint), optional label and selected state; clicking emits its id.
Polyline route drawn through normalized 0-1 map coordinates, optionally animated along its length.
Cluster of zoom in/out, directional pan and recenter controls emitting zoom factor changes (within min..max) and pan deltas in normalized map units.
Read-only key mapping marker kinds to their meaning; entries may be toggled for visibility when a change handler is supplied.

props.entries: { id: string; label: string; kind: string; visible?: boolean }[]

library.description: Ordered list of objective lines, each marked complete, active or pending.

props.items: { id: string; label: string; state: 'done' | 'active' | 'pending'; optional?: boolean }[]
